Class ShipAnimator

java.lang.Object
com.r3m.spaceshooter.system.ShipAnimator
public class ShipAnimator extends Object
ShipAnimator maps the ship's current speed to the correct sprite frame in the spritesheet. The sheet has 25 frames divided into 5 animation zones: Frames 0- 4: idle loop (no movement) Frames 5- 9: light thrust Frames 10-14: medium thrust Frames 15-19: heavy thrust Frames 20-24: max velocity loop The current "position" in the sheet is a float that moves forward (accelerating) or backward (decelerating) based on speed. A separate frame timer cycles through the 5 frames of whichever zone the ship is currently in.

    • getCurrentFrameIndex

      public int getCurrentFrameIndex()
      Returns the index (0-24) of the frame to display this frame. Takes the current zone (derived from animationPosition) and adds the current frame offset within that zone.
      Returns:
      frame index from 0 through 24
